label: The declared Bool probability measure assigns true 19/20 and…, by Finite-probability-threshold…
meaning: The declared Bool probability measure assigns true 19/20 and false 1/20. At threshold 9/10 the policy accepts the proper event {true}, is conjunction closed, and rejects the empty event, while the selected actual alternative false has positive probability and does not satisfy that accepted event. This is a consistent fallible policy model, not an independently warranted actual belief or an account of categorical normativity.
